headline: Be ready for
subhead: Stock up before you need it.
intro: A few essentials at home make a rough week easier. We can help you pick the right ones.

points.title: Check your temperature
points.body: Keep a working thermometer at home so you know when a fever starts.

points.title: Pick the right relief
points.body: Cold products treat different symptoms. Read the label and ask us which one fits.

points.title: Stop the spread
points.body: Wash your hands often and stay home when you're sick.

cta_body: Our pharmacists are happy to help you choose.
reel_hook: 3 things to have at home before flu season
caption_instagram:
Is your home ready for flu season? 🤧

A few essentials make a rough week easier: a working thermometer, the right cold relief for your symptoms, and hand sanitizer by the door. Not sure which cold product fits? Our North York pharmacy team can help you choose.
